name: Displaced Parallel Projection for Stereoscopic Volume Rendering
definition: A viewing geometry for parallel stereoscopic imaging where two view points (Left Center of Projection LCoP and Right Center of Projection RCoP) are separated by distance e. One center is at the origin, the other at (e cos(θ/2), 0, e sin(θ/2)). This setup allows the second half of a stereo pair to be generated from the first by exploiting coherence, reducing rendering time by 70-80%.
